name: Ca bong rim
summary: Vietnam Airlines describes cá bống sông Trà rimmed until dry, as a gift box. The Cẩm Thành ward article says cá bống sông Trà rim mặn ngọt and does not give the dry-box method. The two lines are both printed.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the dry braise lightly chewy and salty-sweet. The ward article’s words are mặn ngọt and do not mention a box.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: after cleaning, braise the fish with fish sauce, sugar, pepper, chili, and garlic until it is dry and evenly seasoned, brown, and fragrant. Eat it with rice or as a snack. The printed pack is a 200 g box.
The Cẩm Thành ward article names the fish rimmed salty-sweet and does not print this dry method.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Airlines names no street. The ward article places the fish on the Trà Khúc.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 90,000 VND for a 200 g box. The ward article printed no price.
seoTitle: Ca bong rim — dried river-goby braise
seoDescription: Vietnam Airlines rims cá bống sông Trà until dry and prints 90,000 VND for 200 g. The ward article says rim mặn ngọt. The hour is Check on arrival.
